additional_sources.title: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus
additional_sources.relevant_claim: cross-mixer architecture-aligned massive-activation diagnostics, controlled early/middle/late single-attention placement, training-time emergence, and module-specific output-gate interventions

new_overlap_decisions.reason: arXiv:2608.12149v2 defines PAS and ISR, verifies their cross-ratio trend with paired bootstrap uncertainty, and observes the morphology across five mixers and large deployed hybrid families
the paper trains matched 24-layer GDN hybrids from scratch with one full-attention layer at depths 4, 12, and 20 and reports large retrieval differences
adding full-attention output gates and removing GDN output gates directly tests module-specific control of spike and plateau magnitude
all three placement arms attain 99.53 to 100 percent alignment despite large and task-dependent retrieval gaps, so alignment does not rank placement quality

residual_assessment.distinction: no audited source freezes a predictor before arbitrary held-out layout outcomes and demonstrates calibrated cross-task, cross-scale, cross-mixer placement prediction
residual_assessment.new_counterevidence: architecture-determined PAS alignment saturates across early, middle, and late placements while retrieval differs sharply; PAS magnitude and gate interventions also do not yield a task-invariant quality ordering
residual_assessment.burden: must add held-out predictive information beyond count, middle/later recipes, LongPPL, retrieval heads, PAS/ISR, probes, sensitivity, greedy conversion, joint gates, and random layouts, then causally improve a selected architecture
residual_assessment.scientific_value: not established and now lower-prior; independent review should explicitly consider retiring N1 before any protocol

source_limitations: the controlled placement comparison has only three 340M layouts and repeats only the middle layout at 1.3B
placement replicates and layout-level confidence intervals are not reported
retrieval tasks disagree and are limited to 2048 or 4096 token contexts
PAS and ISP are measured after a layout is trained rather than prospectively without its outcomes
the exact computational role of PAS versus ISP remains open in the paper

priority.n1: independent claim review should decide retirement versus further landscape work; no protocol or experiment
priority.baseline_proxy: complete independently because it evaluates the conservative parent rather than either novelty claim

decision.next_action: finish the frozen proxy and obtain independent claim-level review on whether N1 should be retired before spending further placement-research effort
